plugins.name: claude-code-extension-engineering
plugins.description: Choose the right Claude Code extension mechanism before you build it: CLAUDE.md and rules, skills, hooks, subagents, dynamic workflows, agent teams, MCP servers, output styles, plugins, LSP, or the Agent SDK. Not a generator or a linter: it answers which mechanism should own a behavior and why the nearest alternative is wrong, distinguishing model-owned behavior from harness-owned enforcement with explicit failure policy and tamper boundary. Includes a selection guide, 18 composition cards, 30 documented hook-event contracts plus changelog-only deltas, dated version gates, and an evidence ledger with drift detection. Use plugin-dev to build components; use this to decide what should be built.
